subject: Can I run seqeunza with WGS and WES

messages.author: 36488b271701c318
messages.subject: Can I run seqeunza with WGS and WES
parts:
Dear Sequenza users,

I have a question about input data for Sequenza.
my cancer sample is sequenced by targeted exome sequencing and the matched normal sample is sequenced by WGS. 
in this case, I wonder how can I prepare Sequenza input file from the above design.

Regards,
-youngjune-
